issues: Fanfare is encoded as a player choice between two damage modes, but the card has no choice; replace the choose effect with a single conditional effect that deals 4 damage if there is another Heroic follower on your field, otherwise 1 damage, to the selected enemy follower.

Last Words is encoded as searchDeckChoose over the top 1 card, which does not preserve 'look at the top card' semantics; encode it as peeking at the top card and, if that card has the Heroic trait, optionally put it into your EX area.

Fanfare should first select a Wasteland follower that costs 3 or less in your cemetery, then under Necrocharge (10) you may summon that selected card; the current summonFromCemetery encoding does not model selecting the specific target before the Necrocharge clause.

Fanfare uses optionalCost incorrectly; Necrocharge (10) is a condition, not a paid cost. Encode the ability as a targeted cemetery selection with a conditional optional summon, and if you do, banish this card.
Keywords incorrectly include fanfare; remove the extra 'fanfare' keyword because the card only has an activated [act] ability.

On Evolve targets are encoded with an unsupported filter inside targets; the effect should target a Golem follower on your field and grant it Rush and Assail. Add engine support for target selectors that can filter field targets by trait/card properties, or a dedicated operation to grant multiple keywords to a filtered allied follower.

The triggered ability timing is wrong; it should trigger when your leader gains defense, not onCardPlayed. Replace it with an ability that triggers on leader healing/defense gain and deals 4 damage to an enemy follower once per turn.
The current conditional enteredFromHand clause is unrelated to the source text and should be removed from the once-per-turn damage ability.
